goldens.comment: The DB methods NewInMemoryDB().RunCommands, DB.QueryFramesInto, and DB.TablesList in pkg/expr/sql/db.go return hardcoded 'not implemented' errors after removing the go-duck dependency.

candidates: The enableSqlExpressions function always returns false regardless of the feature flag state - both the if enabled branch and the fall-through return false, making the feature flag check dead code. The inverted logic (!IsEnabledGlobally) combined with the misleading variable name 'enabled' creates a trap where a future developer 'fixing' this could accidentally re-enable the RCE vulnerability

The new in-memory SQL DB stub returns generic 'not implemented' errors, which upstream code treats/logs as 'invalid sql query'; when legacy parsing paths are used, users can get misleading validation errors even though the feature is intentionally disabled
